claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic generic coding-agent adapter route planner/validator for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes explicit caller-supplied host capability evidence plus release/state-lineage identities and maps only verified host primitives onto the semantic host ABI without product-name guessing. Generic hosts may be ADAPTED when all required semantics are verified, DEGRADED when optional/secondary semantics are missing, and BLOCKED when mandatory durable-state or lifecycle evidence is absent; NATIVE is forbidden unless an explicit release-specific native-support assertion is independently evidenced. Canonical durable F2 state must remain one lineage outside disposable host/plugin/cache roots, and optional VPS/HCU attachment cannot be a prerequisite for baseline local boot. Planning/validation only: no filesystem writes, host probing, package/plugin installation, provider/model/tool calls, UnifiedDB mutation, effects, physical-host installer credit or whole-system completion. Source/tests plus repository-hosted CI only. F2-WP-1101 owns generic host capability discovery/semantic ABI; F2-WP-1102 and F2-WP-1103 own Claude Code and Codex routes and are not modified by this claim.
